trustworthinessScale.holds: emitted the protocol's trusted exact rational for this cell (in-family control with canonical G)
trustworthinessScale.fail-closed: refused or falsified without emitting a finite-sum value (unsupported, domain, input, or identity miss)
trustworthinessScale.silent-wrong: emitted a finite-sum value other than the true sum of the stated summand on the stated bounds (arithmetic; wrong/swapped saved G is the clear case)
trustworthinessScale.silent-accept-out-of-declared-domain: emitted a finite-sum value when the protocol's trusted outcome is no_value because pack declared-domain checks were skipped. The value may be mathematically correct (over-limit) or Karr-conventional (reversed bounds). This is policy no_value, not arithmetic silent-wrong.

workload.family: inclusive finite sums of (k+c)^2 for rational c and integer bounds
workload.question: When does Math Anchor pack + checks fail closed (wrong saved G / out-of-domain / identity or obligation binding failures) while a fair SymPy-side cached template path silently accepts or returns a wrong answer?
workload.whatThePackAddsVersusFairTemplate: independent general and instance identity checks plus declared-domain fail-closed (reversed bounds, |a|,|b|<=10^6). Family matching is not pack-unique: the fair template also refuses 1/k and k^3.

mandatoryClaimZh: 相对公平的 SymPy 侧缓存模板，包加检查在哪些探针上 fail-closed，而模板静默接受或给出错误值？
mandatoryClaimAnswerZh: 相对公平模板（同一条缓存 G 做代入，不做包身份检查，也不做包域检查），包路径在错误保存的 G、交换载荷、反转边界与越界上 fail-closed，而模板给出错误值或静默接受；出族 k^3、1/k 与 parameterC 不一致上双方都拒绝，不是包独有。身份/义务绑定钩子只在包路径上存在。本实验不以时延为主要结论。

arms.description: Fair SymPy-side cached parametric G(k,c). Instantiates without pack identity checks and without pack domain checks (Karr reversed bounds; no |a|,|b|<=10^6 cap) because that models naive reuse. Family matching remains, so the arm is not crippled into applying G to 1/k or k^3. No independent certificate checker.

Frozen shifted-square apply: instantiate saved G; reconstruction disabled. Applicability, general and instance identity, and declared-domain checks must refuse bad cases. Reuses existing apply / certificate / obligation paths.

linear-k.note: Wrong saved G: stripped down to the index. True P1 sum is 355; naive G(b+1)-G(a) is 6.

swapped-cubes-antidifference.note: Swapped payload: Faulhaber antidifference of k^3, not of (k+c)^2. Naive G(8)-G(2)=783.

tasks.notes: Silent accept of declared-domain overflow, not a wrong number. Trust label is silent-accept-out-of-declared-domain. Matching still requires the mathematical exact; garbage values are not a match.

structuralProbes.notes: Strip and typed-binding reuse existing apply / verify_typed_binding paths (A3 / PR13 R1–R3). Not a parallel checker.

latency.note: Informational in-process wall time only. Not a latency bake-off and not a utility claim. equalBudget is zero model calls.

scoring.trustworthiness: Per cell: holds / fail-closed / silent-wrong / silent-accept-out-of-declared-domain as defined in trustworthinessScale. Never collapsed into one success flag.
scoring.behavior: Whether P-pack instantiates saved G (including mutated G) instead of reconstructing. Wrap of gosper_sum / construct_antidifference / summation / Sum.doit is the reconstruction probe.
scoring.utility: Optional secondary only. Not scored as a primary claim in this smoke. Latency is informational if present.
scoring.callAloneIsNotAdoption: must stay true on P-pack apply
scoring.wrongAcceptance: arithmetic silent-wrong: a finite-sum other than trueExact of the stated summand on the stated bounds. Not set for policy silent-accept (Karr / over-limit mathematical exact).
scoring.silentAcceptance: policy no_value: emitted the pre-registered Karr or over-limit exact when pack declared-domain checks were skipped
scoring.matchedPreRegisteredExpectation: observed trust label equals expectedByArm.trust, and when expectedExactIfComputed is set the emitted valueExact must equal it. Any emission is not a silent-wrong match.

decisionRule.promote: Forbidden in this smoke. Do not start H1. Fail-closed vs silent-wrong / silent-accept on one family is not product readiness.
decisionRule.targeted_fix: P-pack emitted a value on wrong/swapped G, P-pack reconstructed, control missed 355, formal_kernel_checked true, coversOriginalTaskClaim true, or stripped payload succeeded on the pack.
decisionRule.evidence_insufficient: Default for promotion. Arithmetic silent-wrong differentiation is wrong/swapped saved G. Domain probes are policy silent-accept. Neither is a promotion case.
